profile.headline: Software Engineer at UpSmith
profile.summary: Hi, I'm a software engineer interested in backend web architecture and application development. Check out my website or my GitHub account for my projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As a software engineer at Outschool, I work to improve the learner's experience by leveraging a full stack of frontend web technologies, backend webserver software, databases, and infrastructure in the cloud.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: As a member of the Analytics Infrastructure division, I worked in a full-stack capacity to ensure that clients can access and manage the data that supports FactSet's analytics products. This involves SQL, C++, as well as front and middle-end JS/TS development.

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description: At CNN, I worked as a web developer on the CNN.com website, where I maintained and expanded the site's feature set. I debugged and developed features for the site's front-end view controller.. Additionally, I worked on CNN.com's NodeJs backend, routing configuration information to the front-end.

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description: I created an app development LLC with a friend of mine in high school, for which I developed Android applications. I also created and managed the Taptools LLC web site, and did freelance web design and development for outside entities under the 'Taptools' banner.

positions.title: Android Developer Intern
positions.description: I wrote a template Android application that graphs and displays data from a web API, for use by Inmar's business customers. I utilized the Android application platform as well as an embedded JavaScript based graphing library.

projects.title: Trail Tracker GPS
projects.description: I participated in the product design and Android development of the Trail Tracker GPS mobile application, which maps, graphs, tracks, and traces user paths using GPS, offering detailed statistics.
